svg.title: IBM i in three of IBM's dates
svg.desc: Three of IBM's dates for IBM i: IBM i 7.6, the current release, generally available April 18, 2025; the Service Extension Offering for IBM i 7.4 runs from October 1, 2026 to September 30, 2029; IBM i 7.5 and 7.6 have no date set, and IBM will give at least 12 months' notice. Each date is IBM's own, from its IBM i lifecycle and release pages.
